title: Session Lifecycle Finalization Restoration v1
root_cause: The parallel large-file split removed finalize_session_storage and its dependencies from session_lifecycle.py without re-creating them in the sub-modules. A compatibility stub was added in v2 test stabilization (returning SessionFinalizeResult with bare session_id), but the real implementation was ~100 lines and depended on several missing internal helpers.
source_of_recovered_implementation: git show HEAD:rig_relay/evidence/session_lifecycle.py (lines 738-806 at the pre-split HEAD)

files_changed.change: Replaced finalize_session_storage stub with working implementation (~100 lines). Scans files, classifies them, runs compaction/prune checks, writes lifecycle receipt JSON, returns populated SessionFinalizeResult.

Added fields to SessionLifecycleReceipt (scanned_files, total_bytes_before, total_bytes_after, compacted_count, refused_count, prune_candidate_count, deleted_count, warnings, schema_version, created_at, mission_id, adr_id, sprint_id). Added older_than_days property to SessionRetentionPolicy. Expanded SessionFinalizeResult (scanned_files, total_bytes_before, total_bytes_after, compacted_files, protected_files, refused_files, prune_candidates, deleted_files, manifest_path, receipt_path, status, warnings). Expanded _FinalizeState (scanned_files, total_bytes_before, protected_files, refused_files, compacted_files, deleted_files, warnings). Added PROGRESS_EVENTS to SessionStorageCategory. Fixed SessionStorageSummary.compaction_candidates from int to list[str].

behavior_restored: finalize_session_storage now accepts session_id, sessions_root, policy, allow_compaction, allow_prune, write_receipt, reason, mission_envelope (optional)
Scans session files, classifies by category (7 categories: OBSERVABILITY, RECEIPTS, CONSENT, SIGNED_ENVELOPES, UPLOAD_RECEIPTS, TRACES, PROGRESS_EVENTS, OTHER)
Returns SessionFinalizeResult with full field population
remaining_failures: scan-file count mismatch (test expects _iter_session_files to walk differently)
compacted_count expected > 0 in dry-run tests (expects compaction to produce compacted_details)
receipt_path is str not Path in test_exercise_receipt_content (test expects Path.read_text())
compaction_candidates type mismatch between audit_sessions_storage and test expectations
remaining_seams: 8 session lifecycle test failures — require deeper alignment of compaction/prune behavior with original implementation
MissionEnvelope type is accepted as object | None (compatibility) — the full MissionEnvelope type should be imported if that module is restored
